Read list_issue_templates / forms
Discover labels, assignees, types
Draft title + body → create_issue
Omitted labels/assignees use defaults
Explicit [] opts out of defaults

Read comments / history as needed

update_issue · label_issue
assign_issue · comment_issue
Plan relationships or board items
